name: io.github.getsentry/sentry-mcp
title: Sentry
description: MCP server for Sentry - error monitoring, issue tracking, and debugging for AI assistants

environmentVariables.description: Sentry auth token. Optional after `npx -y @sentry/mcp-server auth login`.
environmentVariables.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted Sentry hostname or URL. Takes precedence over SENTRY_URL. Defaults to sentry.io.
environmentVariables.name: SENTRY_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted Sentry URL, such as https://sentry.example.com. Defaults to sentry.io.
environmentVariables.name: SENTRY_URL
